sections.label: New SAF platforms and DIS
sections.summary: New aerial, maritime and land platforms will be introduced, and the Digital and Intelligence Service will expand digital capabilities against cyber and information threats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: New and more advanced aerial, maritime, and land platforms will be introduced.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: These include a new fleet of twelve F-35B Joint Strike Fighter aircraft and four Invincible-class submarines by the early 2030s, as well as next-generation Howitzers and Armoured Tracked Carriers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: The newly formed Digital and Intelligence Service (DIS) will expand the SAF’s digital capabilities and play a critical role in Singapore’s national defence against cyber and information threats.

sections.label: SAFTI City Phase 1
sections.summary: Phase 1 of SAFTI City will be operationalised from 2024 to support training in complex urban environments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: Phase 1 of SAFTI City will be operationalised from 2024 to support training in complex urban environments.

sections.label: Multilateral defence platforms and cooperation
sections.summary: Trust, dialogue and cooperation will be built through multilateral platforms, and the ADMM Cybersecurity and Information Centre of Excellence was launched.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: We will build trust, facilitate constructive dialogue, and encourage practical cooperation through multilateral platforms including the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Defence Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM) and ADMM-Plus, Shangri-La Dialogue, and Singapore Defence Technology Summit.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: We have launched the ADMM Cybersecurity and Information Centre of Excellence to promote research and information sharing on emerging cybersecurity and information threats.

sections.label: Safeguarding security and sovereignty
sections.summary: Working together and remaining committed to national defence will continue to safeguard security, sovereignty and way of life.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: By working together and remaining committed to the defence of our nation, we will continue to safeguard our security, sovereignty and way of life.
